title: AnomalyDiffusion: Few-Shot Anomaly Image Generation with Diffusion Model
mechanism: Latent diffusion with a spatial anomaly embedding (learned appearance + mask-encoded location) and adaptive attention re-weighting toward weakly generated regions for aligned anomaly image-mask pairs.
adaptation: Benchmark baseline for the synthetic-data track: train per class (crack, inactive) on train cells with grey replicated to 3 channels; report against pixel-space renderers at matched sample count.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + AnomalyDiffusion samples. Baseline: rows 1 and 2 at matched count, PF 5 seeds. Metric: E1 relF1@2 (crack), CV inactive IoU. Reported, no kill.
evidence: R: better generation authenticity and diversity on MVTec and improved downstream inspection (abstract); 192 citations. Code github.com/sjtuplayer/anomalydiffusion stated in paper, not opened.
